# Asian Donors Guide: Supporting Disabled Women in Kenya From Mumbai to Tokyo, Singapore to Manila—compassion knows no borders. Asian donors are increasingly supporting causes in Africa, creating a powerful bridge of humanity between the world's two most populous continents. This guide shows donors from India 🇮🇳, China 🇨🇳, Japan 🇯🇵, Singapore 🇸🇬, Philippines 🇵🇭, and across Asia how to safely support Mary and Lydia, two disabled women in Kenya who need wheelchairs, medical care, and education. ## 📋 Table of Contents 1. [Why Asian-African Giving Matters](#why-asian-african) 2. [Currency Guide: Your Money Goes Further](#currency-guide) 3. [Payment Methods for Asian Donors](#payment-methods) 4. [Country-Specific Donation Guide](#country-guide) 5. [Mary & Lydia's Story](#story) 6. [Tax Benefits (If Applicable)](#tax-benefits) 7. [How to Verify Legitimacy](#verification) --- ## 🌏 Why Asian-African Giving Matters ### **The Cultural Bridge** Asia and Africa share deep historical connections: - Both continents faced colonialism - Both prioritize community and family values - Both understand the struggle for dignity and opportunity - Both celebrate resilience in the face of adversity When you—an Asian donor—support Mary & Lydia in Kenya, you're not just giving money. You're building a bridge of solidarity between two continents that together represent **77% of the world's population**. ### **The Impact Multiplier (Currency Advantage)** Your Asian currency has **massive purchasing power** in Kenya:
| **Your Country** | **Your Currency** | **= Kenya Shillings** | **Impact** | |------------------|-------------------|-----------------------|------------| | 🇮🇳 India | ₹100 INR | 156 KES | 2x local buying power | | 🇸🇬 Singapore | $100 SGD | 9,565 KES | 5x local buying power | | 🇯🇵 Japan | ¥10,000 JPY | 10,400 KES | 4x local buying power | | 🇨🇳 China | ¥100 CNY | 1,780 KES | 3x local buying power | | 🇵🇭 Philippines | ₱1,000 PHP | 2,240 KES | 2x local buying power |
**What this means:** Your ₹4,000 INR donation = 1 month of comprehensive care for Mary & Lydia (In India, ₹4,000 might only buy 1 week of similar care) --- ## 💱 Currency Guide: Your Money Goes Further ### **Donation Impact by Country** #### **🇮🇳 India (INR - Rupees)**

PayPal (Best for Most Asian Countries)** **Accepted from:** - ✅ India, Singapore, Japan, China, Philippines, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Hong Kong, South Korea **How to donate:** 1. Go to: [/donate](/donate) 2. Click "Donate with PayPal" 3. Choose amount in your currency 4. PayPal auto-converts to USD/KES 5. Receive instant receipt **Fees:** - India: No foreign transaction fee (PayPal India) - Singapore: Small conversion fee (~3%) - Japan: 4% foreign transaction fee - China: Limited availability (use credit card) --- #### 💳 **2. Credit/Debit Card (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX)** **Accepted worldwide via Stripe** **How to donate:** 1. Select "Credit/Debit Card" on donate page 2. Enter card details (secure Stripe processing) 3. Amount charged in USD 4. Your bank converts currency 5. Receive instant receipt **Currency Conversion:** - India: Check with your bank for forex rates - Singapore: Usually 1-2% markup - Japan: 2-3% forex fee - International cards recommended --- #### ₿ **3. Cryptocurrency (Bitcoin, USDT)** **Perfect for:** - Large donations (₹50,000+ INR, $500+ SGD, ¥50,000+ JPY) - Tech-savvy donors - Minimizing fees (1-2% vs 3-5% traditional) **How to donate:** 1. Select "Cryptocurrency" on donate page 2. Choose Bitcoin or USDT (TRC20) 3. Send to provided wallet address 4. Blockchain confirmation in minutes 5. Tax receipt provided --- ### **Coming Soon (Q1 2025):** #### **🇮🇳 India:** - ✅ UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm) - ✅ NEFT/RTGS bank transfer - ✅ Razorpay integration #### **🇸🇬 Singapore:** - ✅ PayNow - ✅ FAST bank transfer - ✅ GrabPay #### **🇯🇵 Japan:** - ✅ PayPay - ✅ Line Pay - ✅ Konbini payment (7-Eleven, FamilyMart) #### **🇨🇳 China:** - ✅ Alipay (支付宝) - ✅ WeChat Pay (微信支付) - ✅ UnionPay #### **🇵🇭 Philippines:** - ✅ GCash - ✅ PayMaya - ✅ Remittance services (Western Union, MoneyGram) --- ## 🌏 Country-Specific Donation Guide ### **🇮🇳 For Indian Donors:** **Recommended Payment Method:** 1. PayPal (no foreign transaction fee) 2. Credit card (check forex markup with bank) 3. UPI (coming Q1 2025) **Tax Benefits:** - If AbleHearts gets 12A/80G registration: 50% tax deduction - Currently: No Indian tax deduction (pending registration) - Keep receipt for potential future claims **Currency Tip:** - ₹1,000 INR = 1,560 KES = 1 week comprehensive care - ₹5,000 INR = 7,800 KES = 1 month + wheelchair repair **Cultural Connection:** Mary & Lydia's story resonates with Indian values: - **Karma:** Your good deed creates positive karma - **Seva:** Selfless service to those in need - **Dharma:** Moral duty to help the less fortunate --- ### **🇸🇬 For Singaporean Donors:** **Recommended Payment Method:** 1. Credit card via Stripe (Visa/Mastercard) 2. PayPal 3. PayNow (coming soon) **Tax Benefits:** - Tax deduction available if AbleHearts gets IPC status - Currently: Not tax-deductible in Singapore - Apply for Community Chest matching (pending) **Currency Tip:** - $50 SGD = 4,782 KES = 1 month medical care - $100 SGD = 9,565 KES = 3 months food + medicine **Why Singaporeans give:** - Strong culture of giving (SG Cares, Community Chest) - 义 (yì - righteousness) and 仁 (rén - compassion) - Desire for transparent, impactful giving --- ### **🇯🇵 For Japanese Donors:** **Recommended Payment Method:** 1. Credit card (JCB accepted via Stripe) 2. PayPal Japan 3. PayPay (coming soon) **Tax Benefits:** - Potentially deductible if donation exceeds ¥2,000 - Must be through approved NPO (pending for AbleHearts) - Keep receipt for tax filing **Currency Tip:** - ¥5,000 = 5,200 KES = 2 weeks comprehensive care - ¥10,000 = 10,400 KES = 1 month full support **Cultural Values:** - **義理 (giri):** Social obligation to help those in need - **思いやり (omoiyari):** Empathy and consideration - **恩 (on):** Sense of debt/gratitude to community --- ### **🇨🇳 For Chinese Donors:** **Recommended Payment Method:** 1. Credit card (UnionPay accepted) 2. Cryptocurrency (popular in China) 3. Alipay/WeChat Pay (coming Q1 2025) **Tax Benefits:** - Chinese tax deduction available through approved foundations - Currently: Not registered for Chinese tax benefits - International donors: Keep receipt for records **Currency Tip:** - ¥500 CNY = 8,900 KES = 3 weeks full care - ¥1,000 CNY = 17,800 KES = 6 weeks support **Cultural Connection:** - **慈善 (císhàn):** Charity and compassion - **功德 (gōngdé):** Merit from good deeds - **爱心 (àixīn):** Love and care for others --- ### **🇵🇭 For Filipino Donors:** **Recommended Payment Method:** 1. PayPal Philippines 2. Credit/debit card 3. GCash/PayMaya (coming soon) **Tax Benefits:** - Philippine donors: Not currently tax-deductible - OFW remittance friendly (use Wise, Sendwave) **Currency Tip:** - ₱1,000 PHP = 2,240 KES = 1 week medical care - ₱5,000 PHP = 11,200 KES = 1 month support **Bayanihan Spirit:** - Community helping community - Overseas Filipinos supporting global causes - Remittance culture = easy international giving --- ## 💖 Mary & Lydia's Story #### Lydia's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Lydia's testimonial on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751420) #### Mary's Story
**Can't see the video?** [Watch Mary's story on Vimeo](https://vimeo.com/1140751723) ### **Why Asian Donors Connect with Their Story** Mary (disabled mother) and Lydia (disabled daughter) live in rural Kenya with severe mobility challenges. After losing their primary caregiver in 2019, they survive on less than $3/day—similar to poverty levels in rural Asia. **Before International Donors:** - 😢 No wheelchair (Mary crawled for hours) - 🏥 Untreated wounds (couldn't afford ₹1,000 INR equivalent) - 🏚️ Leaking roof - 📚 Lydia couldn't attend school (fees = ₹15,000 INR/year) **After Asian Donors Helped:** - ♿ Indian donor: Sponsored wheelchair (₹40,000 INR) - 🏥 Singaporean donor: Monthly medical care ($50 SGD/month) - 📚 Japanese donor: School fees for Lydia (¥20,000 JPY/year) **Your donation continues their transformation.** --- ## 🧾 Tax Benefits (If Applicable) ### **Countries with Potential Tax Deductions:** **🇮🇳 India:** - Section 80G: 50% deduction (if AbleHearts gets 12A registration) - Section 80GGA: 100% deduction for research/rural development - Keep receipt and Form 10BE **🇸🇬 Singapore:** - IPC status: 250% tax deduction (pending application) - Donate via Community Chest for matching **🇯🇵 Japan:** - ¥2,000+ donations may be deductible - NPO certification required (pending) **🇨🇳 China:** - Deductible up to 30% of annual income - Must be through approved foundation **🇵🇭 Philippines:** - Corporate donations: Deductible - Individual donations: Limited deductibility --- ## 🔎 How to Verify Legitimacy ### **Asian Donors: Verify AbleHearts is Real** #### **1. Donor Testimonials** - Read reviews from other Asian donors - Join WhatsApp donor group - Ask questions directly --- ## ✅ Quick Donation Checklist (Asian Donors) Before donating, verify: - [ ] Website is secure (https://) - [ ] PayPal/Stripe badge visible - [ ] Real beneficiary names (Mary & Lydia) - [ ] Monthly updates promised - [ ] Currency conversion clearly shown - [ ] Tax receipt provided (if applicable) - [ ] Contact information available - [ ] Social media active - [ ] Video proof available - [ ] Other Asian donors verified **If ALL checked → Safe to donate! 🟢** --- ## 🚀 Ready to Make an Impact? ### **Why Asian Donors Choose AbleHearts:** 1. **Cultural Alignment:** - Values: Community, family, compassion - Shared history: Colonialism, poverty, resilience - Bridge building: Asia ↔ Africa solidarity 2. **Financial Transparency:** - 100% goes to Mary & Lydia - No CEO salaries, no admin costs - Public expense reports 3. **Currency Advantage:** - Your money = 2-5x impact - Clear conversion rates - No hidden fees 4. **Easy Payment:** - PayPal (most Asian countries) - Credit card (Visa, Mastercard, UnionPay) - Crypto (Bitcoin, USDT) - Local methods coming soon --- ## 🌍 Asian-African Unity When you donate from India, Singapore, Japan, China, or Philippines to help Mary & Lydia in Kenya, you're proving that: - **Borders don't limit compassion** - **Currency differences don't stop giving** - **Language barriers don't prevent understanding** - **Distance doesn't weaken empathy** You're part of a **global movement** uniting Asia and Africa through shared humanity. --- ## 📞 Questions?
